assumptions: Ground-truth RAW/WAW from final committed RW (beneficiary and basic_lazy excluded), same definition as dependency_edges. WAR is a reader strictly between two writers of ℓ. k is the product-path VmDb storage/basic/code ordinal inside the incarnation, plus finalize writes after those reads. Writes become knowable to other txs at publish, not at the SSTORE opcode; this path does not switch to inspect_run. A block is a true edge only when (peer, tx, ℓ) is a ground-truth RAW or WAW. live is last_writer_before that is not scheduler-done at the read. pe is learner.location_predicted. Quiet proceeds are kept only for the first 32 per tx; blocks, proceed-while-live, writes, and non-commit resolves are kept up to 4000. Sums n_read/n_block/n_pe are full counters. Soft=0. One cold + one reuse. Host may have fewer cores than requested.
